facts.claim: Mr J. F. Fiddian of the Madras Civil Service was proposed as a candidate for a Masonic Lodge in Secunderabad or Hyderabad.
facts.quote: At this Meeting Mr J. F. Fiddian of the Madras Civil Service was proposed as a candidate.

facts.claim: The only members of the Civil Service in Hyderabad are, as a rule, those connected with the Residency and it sometimes happens that these are Military officers.
facts.quote: The only members of the Civil Service in Hyderabad are, as a rule, those connected with the Residency and it sometimes happens that these are Military officers.

facts.claim: Each Lodge or Chapter worked on its own and used the building for liquor bills, with tradesmen putting down all bills to St. Johns.
facts.quote: Each Lodge or Chapter worked on " its own." All made use of the building and the tradesmen put down all bills to St. Johns,
